'''Urrisov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a technician for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. In [[3642 BBY]], he was assigned to a salvage crew that were in charge of recovering the [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]] ''[[Deference]]'', but the site was captured by the [[Hero of Tython]] and the [[301st Infantry]]. After he surrendered himself to them, Urrisov was convinced to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].
